ideas.pitch: A high-resolution urban green-space mapping app that uses satellite imagery and NDVI analysis to calculate tree canopy coverage and shade equity for campus and surrounding urban areas.
ideas.title: CanopyCheck SRMIST
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a core focus area of GEOIMPathon 1.0 and provides concrete, quantifiable metrics on urban heat island vulnerability that municipal judges can instantly visualize on a live map.

ideas.pitch: A water resource management dashboard that monitors local reservoir levels and surface water turbidity using multispectral satellite data combined with crowd-sourced ground validation.
ideas.title: Aqueduct AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of using hard geospatial datasets (multispectral satellite bands) to deliver a clear, measurable environmental impact score for local water bodies.

ideas.pitch: An agricultural sustainability tool that tracks crop health stress and soil moisture deficits using temporal satellite indices to help local farmers optimize irrigation schedules.
ideas.title: AgriPulse Spatial
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the evaluation panel's priority for practical, economic solutions that directly impact local livelihoods and food security through accessible geospatial insights.

ideas.pitch: A disaster management and risk analysis platform that overlays elevation models with historical rainfall data to simulate urban waterlogging and flash flood evacuation routes.
ideas.title: EcoDrain Risk Map
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages live-working spatial simulations which consistently impress hackathon judges by demonstrating immediate utility during emergency scenarios.

ideas.pitch: An environmental monitoring dashboard that calculates campus and local industrial carbon footprints by combining nighttime light intensity data with localized vegetation indices.
ideas.title: CarbonLens Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the winning pattern of combining unconventional remote sensing data proxies with an intuitive dashboard that faculty members and expert evaluators can test live.
